tool_args.rationale: The pilot favors the gradient-modulated, two-state siphon-memory mechanism, but its five endpoint measurements do not reliably identify five parameters. The trajectory batch adds observations to help separate memory relaxation from coupling before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations at similar horizons can trade off memory coupling and relaxation time without reliably identifying both.

considered_alternatives.option: Uncoupled Kelvin–Voigt or damped oscillator model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither uses the observed memory state or spatial gradient, so neither accounts for the coupled lag and gradient-dependent sink signatures.
It is not offered, and the pilot shows no narrow-gradient collinearity.
It does not constrain the coupled transient.
